name: Dhaulagiri I
description: The 7th-highest mountain on Earth; its name means 'white mountain'. The Kali Gandaki gorge, one of the deepest in the world, separates it from Annapurna.

name: Manaslu
description: The 8th-highest mountain on Earth, first climbed by a Japanese expedition in 1956. Its name means 'mountain of the spirit'.

name: Annapurna I
description: The 10th-highest mountain on Earth and the first 8,000 m peak ever climbed, by a French expedition in 1950. Its name means 'full of food', after the goddess of harvests.

name: Annapurna East
description: One of the summits of the Annapurna I massif, along the ridge east of the main peak.

name: Annapurna II
description: The eastern anchor of the Annapurna range and its second-highest summit after Annapurna I.

name: Himalchuli
description: The highest peak of the Mansiri Himal, just south of Manaslu. Over 7,800 m, yet far less known than its neighbour.

name: Baraha Shikhar (Annapurna Fang Peak)
description: Also called Annapurna Fang: a steep, fang-shaped peak just west of Annapurna I.

name: Annapurna III
description: A high summit in the middle of the Annapurna range. From Pokhara it rises just to the right of and behind Machhapuchhre.

name: Annapurna IV
description: Sits close to Annapurna II on the eastern part of the Annapurna range.

name: Gangapurna
description: Named after the goddess Ganga. It towers over the village of Manang on the north side of the Annapurna range.

name: Annapurna South
description: The broad white peak that dominates the view from Pokhara, Ghandruk and Poon Hill. Also called Annapurna Dakshin or Moditse.

name: Tilicho Peak
description: Rises above Tilicho Lake, one of the highest lakes in the world, on the Annapurna Circuit side of the range.

name: Nilgiri North
description: The highest of the three Nilgiri ('blue mountain') peaks, standing above Jomsom in the Kali Gandaki valley.

name: Machhapuchhre
description: The 'Fishtail' mountain, named for its split twin summit. Sacred to Shiva and closed to climbing; its summit has never officially been reached.

name: Lamjung Himal
description: The easternmost high peak of the Annapurna range, above the Lamjung district.

name: Tukuche Peak
description: A high peak in the Dhaulagiri Himal, rising above the Kali Gandaki valley and the village of Tukuche.

name: Hiunchuli
description: Stands in front of Annapurna South and guards the entrance to the Annapurna Sanctuary.

name: Gandharba Chuli
description: A sharp peak on the rim of the Annapurna Sanctuary, close to Machhapuchhre.

name: Tent Peak (Tharpu Chuli)
description: A popular trekking peak climbed from Annapurna Base Camp, named for its tent-like shape.

name: Mardi Himal
description: The small summit at the foot of Machhapuchhre, which gives its name to the popular Mardi Himal trek.

name: Samdo Himal
